A1.justification: Both are readable 12-page versions of the same PRISMamba paper. Text and visual comparisons establish unchanged research content. Neither supplied PDF includes an appendix; both refer to forthcoming supplementary material.

before.justification: Section 4 and Tables 1–6 report original classification, COCO detection and instance-segmentation results, channel-filtering ablations, and rotation and occlusion experiments.

after.justification: Section 4 and Tables 1–6 retain the same original benchmark results, channel-filtering ablations, and robustness experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same alternating ring traversal, ring aggregation, radial SSM propagation, partial channel filtering and residual fusion. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate ImageNet-1K classification, rotation and random-mask occlusion scenarios, and MS COCO detection and instance segmentation. No dataset, task or tested scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in every corresponding table, including the Vision-Mamba comparisons, SE and CBAM in Table 5, and VMamba and LocalMamba-T in Table 6.

E3.justification: Both retain the same 224×224 classification inputs, 300-epoch training with batch size 128, COCO mini-val evaluation with a 1× schedule, and rotation and occlusion protocols. Metrics and model configurations are unchanged.

E4.justification: The channel-filtering ablations, transfer across backbones, soft-attention comparisons, rotation tests and occlusion tests are identical. Both versions promise additional scan-order ablations in supplementary material without including them.

E5.justification: Both report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for their own experiments. Parenthetical accuracy drops are unchanged and do not represent uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–6 and the accompanying findings are unchanged. Both report PRISMamba at 84.5% ImageNet Top-1, 3.9G FLOPs and 3,054 img/s, and COCO results of 48.9 box AP and 43.2 mask AP.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains identical mathematical definitions, Equations (1)–(10), recurrences and complexity arguments. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about scan-order sensitivity, rotation robustness, partial channel filtering and accuracy–efficiency advantages.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning fixed image centers, discrete ring widths, off-center subjects, extreme aspect ratios and rotation-induced padding.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, optimizer settings, augmentation details and A100 throughput measurement information are identical. Both retain the statement that code will be released upon acceptance.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning and all 84 references are unchanged. The added author does not introduce a change in cited research or scientific positioning.

P1.justification: The first page adds Kuan-Chuan Peng, moves Jun-Wei Hsieh to the final author position, revises affiliation wording and updates the version/date. Research prose, terminology and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author block changes from one centered author above two paired rows to three paired rows. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–6 are unchanged; pages 2–12 render identically.

improvement.justification: The revision changes authorship, affiliations and their first-page arrangement while retaining the same methods, evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information. These edits leave the paper's scientific and expository quality essentially unchanged.
